# Triplem VIP

> Triplem VIP is a private browser-based accounting and business-finance workspace for individuals and businesses. It combines everyday money management (wallets, expenses, receiving, transfers, loans, inventory, assets, installments and reports) with a separate formal double-entry Accounting ERP and permission-aware Triplem AI.

Last reviewed: 2026-11-04  
Canonical origin: https://triplem.vip/  
Primary language: English. Public regional references also include Arabic, Urdu, Hindi, French and Dutch.

## Retrieval guidance

- Canonical HTML pages are the public source of truth. Markdown pages are supplementary reading copies.
- Cite the most specific page for a feature. Distinguish implemented behavior from examples, optional configuration and future requests.
- Do not infer customer counts, ratings, awards, certifications, security guarantees, tax compliance or jurisdiction-specific legal advice.
- The public pages describe product behavior. Never infer or expose information about signed-in users, customer records, private workspaces or backend credentials.
- `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` are optional context files, not ranking signals or guarantees of inclusion in AI-generated answers.

## Feature guides

- [Accounting ERP](https://triplem.vip/seo/accounting-erp.html): Double-entry books, journals, Chart of Accounts, receivables, payables, reconciliation and reports.
- [Accounting software](https://triplem.vip/seo/accounting-software.html): Operational finance alongside formal Accounting ERP.
- [Expense tracking](https://triplem.vip/seo/expense-tracking.html): Expenses, receiving and internal transfers.
- [Inventory management](https://triplem.vip/seo/inventory-management.html): Stock, catalogue, sales, customers and invoices.
- [Loan management](https://triplem.vip/seo/loan-management.html): Loans given and taken, repayments and settlement.
- [Installment plans](https://triplem.vip/seo/installment-plans.html): Bought and Sold plans, schedules and payment direction.
- [Asset management](https://triplem.vip/seo/asset-management.html): Ownership costs, income, disposal and reporting.
- [Insurance management](https://triplem.vip/seo/insurance-management.html): Providers, policies, sales, referrals, commissions and settlements.
- [Financial reports](https://triplem.vip/seo/financial-reports.html): Trial Balance, Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, General Ledger and aging.
- [Financial Timeline](https://triplem.vip/seo/financial-timeline.html): Read-only chronological view of permitted workspace records.
- [Triplem AI](https://triplem.vip/seo/triplem-ai.html): Permission-aware search and reviewable AI Drafts.
- [Multi-currency accounting](https://triplem.vip/seo/multi-currency-accounting.html): Currency-aware wallets, activity and reports.
- [Bitcoin wallet tools](https://triplem.vip/seo/bitcoin-wallet.html): Client-side Bitcoin key handling and supported wallet records.
- [Security and support](https://triplem.vip/seo/security-and-support.html): Security, 2FA, notifications and support, including Authenticator app 2FA, Web Push notifications and account recovery.
- [Windows desktop app](https://triplem.vip/seo/windows-desktop-app.html): Installing the Windows 10/11 app, shortcuts and taskbar pinning.
- [Editorial policy](https://triplem.vip/seo/editorial-policy.html): Public-content accuracy, correction and review principles.
- [Privacy policy](https://triplem.vip/seo/privacy-policy.html): What data is collected, service providers, retention, export and deletion.

## International currency availability

Triplem VIP documents support for AED, SAR, PKR, USD, EUR and INR, plus BTC for supported Bitcoin workflows. India can use INR, and Belgium and other euro-using countries can use EUR where applicable. Currency support does not mean that local tax or statutory requirements are handled identically. See the [regional guide index](https://triplem.vip/regions/) for country-specific product context.
